title: Article 170 — Composition of the Legislative Assemblies

content.overview: Article 170 provides that the Legislative Assembly of each State shall consist of not more than five hundred and not less than sixty members chosen by direct election from territorial constituencies in the State. The ratio between seats and population is, so far as practicable, the same throughout the State. Readjustment after each census is provided for, with freeze provisions linked to the post-2026 census similar in spirit to the Union provisions.
content.glance: State Assembly: 60–500 members; direct election from territorial constituencies; population-proportionate; readjustment after census (with freeze until post-2026).
content.study:
Article 170 composition:
- Not more than 500 and not less than 60 members.
- Chosen by direct election from territorial constituencies in the State.
- Allocation and division such that the ratio between seats and population is, so far as practicable, the same throughout the State.
- Readjustment upon completion of each census by authority and in manner provided by parliamentary law; inter-census freeze provisions apply in line with constitutional amendments (post-2026 census for full readjustment of seats among constituencies as applicable).

Examination: 60–500 range; direct election; population ratio; census readjustment/freeze.

sections.heading: Key rules
sections.body:
1. Strength: not more than 500, not less than 60.
2. Direct election from territorial constituencies.
3. Population-proportionate allocation so far as practicable.
4. Readjustment after each census (subject to constitutional freeze until post-2026 census as applicable).

questionsAndAnswers.question: What is the composition of a State Legislative Assembly under Article 170?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 170, the Legislative Assembly of each State consists of not more than five hundred and not less than sixty members chosen by direct election from territorial constituencies in the State. Seats are allocated so that the ratio between the number of seats and the population is, so far as practicable, the same throughout the State. Readjustment is made upon completion of each census as provided by law, subject to constitutional freeze provisions until after the first census post-2026.

notes: Composition verified; freeze parallel to Union noted.
